'''2009 Coruscant Regionals Joe Streleckis LS Kashyyyk (Light) (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Joe Streleckis]] at [[2009 Coruscant Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Kashyyyk (Light) (V) (Virtual Set 16: Revenge Of The Sith)|OVS16-15-Kashyyyk-remaster.webp|label=Kashyyyk (Light) (V)}}
* '''Deck name:''' Kashyyk
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS17]]
